Playing for a long time.
Very good game.
But I like this game because of developers. Game keeps evolving, and it evolves mostly on community reviews.
I reccomend it.
great game, great dev team backing it up, great updates

INTRO:

So, I've been around since the closed beta of this game...and ONE thing is for sure. You will hardly find any other online game that evolves as rapidly as this one and grows in size so continuously.(You can see that the devs truly love the game, and not just the money it generates)
The classic space ninjas theme has over the years evolved to more of a mercenary theme with many influences. 


THE GAME:

There is no good or bad, there is just balance. Set thousands of years in the future, you have just been woken up from your cryogenic sleep.

You are a Tenno, controlling one of the many Warframes available to you and you basically answer to the Lotus, which is an organization and a "person" at the same time. Your ultimate goal would be to bring balance to the solar system again...because fact is, bringing peace is not an option. 

Rather than being a white knight in shining armor you will have to set priorities on who to fight and who to help...and your priorities can and WILL re-align at times...either because you want it...or because the majority of Tenno are willing it.

Your tools are abilities, companions, guns, and melee weaponry. Sometimes you have to kill, sometimes to infiltrate or rescue...but what you do is entirely your choice.


LONG TERM:

Now, nothing is wrong with hopping onto a survival match for 20 minutes or just doing a few boss runs and logging off again...but you probably wonder:" Can I invest more than a few hours? What can I do in the long term?"

And the game devs got you covered there. 

The first and most obvious goal would probably be to try and build/aquire all weapons and characters you like and perfect them...of course this is not for everyone, as some pieces of gear, especially for new players, can feel grindy to aquire. Once you are a veteran, this will be of no concern to you as resources come to you naturally.

Then there are things like Syndicates that you can join and run missions for to gain standing. Some factions even give you goals that are shared with all other Tenno that upon completion grant you access to new bits of lore of the world or other rewards.

PVP also exists...and is entirely optional. But capture the cephalon (flag) or deathmatch/ TDM all exist.

And finally there are events and quests/challenges. The devs will regularly add story driven events where the entirety of the community can partake...and sometimes, due to the mercenary nature of the Tenno...will have to split to follow the path that they think is right. But do not be fooled, events can actually fail. Not every mission is about glory...and the higher the payroll, the more ruthless the enemy.



THE CASH SHOP

The item mall is very fair...as in, the initial prices will look very scary until you realize that you don't have to pay for any of it and can still get it at a very acceptable pace. 
The only thing that can't be aquired with ingame currency are some style items....for which you can still trade some items for premium currency to unlock it, anyway.
Additionally there is a chance to get discounts for premium currency as login bonus (up to 75%) and the Steam packs are on sale on pretty much every big steam sale event with 50%-66% discount....at which point everything in the mall becomes absurdly cheap.

So basically...if you are an impulse buyer that can not restrain himself at all, this game might not be entirely for you. But if you are a freeloader looking for a fair game or someone who either wants to do trades or only spend on games for a budget with discounts....you will do just fine here.

Lastly, developers have even pulled cash shop items from the market within very short time periods whenever something was added that the community disagreed with strongly...which was never pay to win...but generally about taking it a little too far with style items. (Pay to win does not exist in their cash shop, pretty much only pay to sleep...which is something you will understand once you start playing, sort of a running gag)



THE DEVELOPERS:

I can not stress this enough. The developers love their GAME. It is more than just a product to them. They have livestreams every week and will directly communicate changes and content updates with the playerbase..and necessarily change it if the players dislike it. 

This goes as far as affecting the cash shop.(see above). They constantly seek to improve their game and they have redone entire game systems and polished the graphics multiple times. DX12 support is also announced and currently PBR (physically based rendering) is being implemented step by step.

They even did things like changing the CORE multiple times in hopes to imrove it. 8 out of 10 times they succeed...and when they fail..they simply try again. It's that simple for them. 

As for content, they have concrete plans what they add and every 2 weeks they showcase what they are working on to players in their devstreams. Depending on feedback this will of course change...but that's why they do it.

The only thing that you CANNOT expect...is anything to last forever in that game. Even core gameplay elements can still change. The devs simply try to improve the game as much as they can and follow their vision...which sometimes clashes with players' opinions.


PERSONAL OPINION:

I LOVED the game so far. It is true that I went on hiatus 3 or 4 times for a month or so with this game. But keep in mind that the game and all of its content (except for some style items) are essentially free...so you can just pick it up again whenever new content is added or they changed some game systems.

Of course this game is not for everyone. But if you want fluent combat. This is yours.
